tickets.title: Reconcile delivery branches and establish a reproducible green baseline
tickets.evidence: main ends at PR 28; frontend-dev contains PRs 29–35; another remote branch contains administration UI. Local HEAD 572c6b0 plus 123 changed/untracked paths is a fourth implementation state. Fresh local API run: 625 passed, 4 assignment-audit failures.
acceptance: Inventory main, frontend-dev, backend_dev, TR-036 administration branch, and local changes by feature; retain every distinct implementation before integration.
Split local identity, follow-up/Today, work-queue and assignment changes into reviewable commits with their migrations and tests; do not publish them as an undifferentiated snapshot.
Repair stale assignment authorization test doubles without weakening assertions for same-transaction audit and audit-failure rollback.

On the agreed integration branch pass lint, formatting, typecheck, API/web/worker/jobs unit suites, builds, fresh-database migrations and API/worker integration suites; attach exact commands and commit SHA.
Add the worker integration suite to CI; retain package-manager signature verification. Record every environment limitation instead of treating skipped checks as passing.

tickets.title: Enforce six-role capabilities and read-only Director/Auditor behavior
tickets.evidence: Current getOverrideAuthority and getAssignmentAuthority explicitly return director; the supplied six-role design forbids Director operational mutations. Existing names are client_admin and observer.
acceptance: Publish a capability matrix mapping tenant_admin to client_admin and auditor to observer without silently rewriting persisted roles.

Deny assignment, override, campaign, contact and lifecycle mutations for Director-only and Observer-only sessions; permit scoped reads, personal preferences/saved views and explicitly authorized audited exports.
Keep platform authority outside tenant roles; tenant role administration cannot mint platform access.
Test each mutation over HTTP with all six role classes, cross-tenant IDs, wrong team, wrong campaign and revoked grants; define mixed-grant behavior explicitly.

tickets.title: Complete identity-to-membership cutover and explicit workspace sessions
tickets.evidence: Local migrations 0024/0025 and identity-backed sessions exist, but same-ID compatibility membership is required and operational actors still reference legacy users.
acceptance: Verify Phase B on a disposable upgraded database, including forced relogin and exact identity/membership/tenant binding.
Migrate grants and operational actor references to tenant membership through forward migrations with reconciliation counts and orphan checks.
Support distinct identity and membership IDs plus explicit selection among active memberships; switching workspace rotates context and cannot retain previous-tenant permissions.
Test suspended identity, membership and tenant, refresh reuse, concurrent switch, old tokens and worker actors; remove compatibility mirrors only after migration evidence.

tickets.title: Introduce restricted database roles and transaction-local request context
tickets.evidence: Database provider uses one DATABASE_URL and Pool connectionString; repositories do not yet share a mandatory transaction-local tenant/actor context.
acceptance: Separate migration, authentication, API and worker privileges; runtime roles cannot own tables, bypass RLS or alter policies.
Bind verified tenant/membership context with transaction-local parameterized settings on the exact connection used by repositories.
Provide a bounded global-identity lookup path without general cross-tenant business access.
Configure validated TLS/pool/connect/query/statement/idle limits and application names for API and worker.
Prove context does not leak on pooled reuse, transaction failure or concurrent requests; document deploy and rollback order.

tickets.title: Enforce row-level security and append-only database privileges
tickets.evidence: Current canonical schema has tenant composite foreign keys, but no RLS policies; reference SQL protects only four tables and does not FORCE RLS.
acceptance: Inventory every tenant/PII table and explicitly justify platform/global exceptions; add SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies and FORCE RLS where applicable.
Use non-owner runtime roles in tests; absent, invalid and mismatched context must fail closed.
Reject cross-tenant parent references, joins, exports and background jobs at the database boundary.
Revoke runtime update/delete on immutable activity, audit, collision-decision and outcome evidence; corrections append events.
Run adversarial API and worker tests including connection-pool reuse and migration upgrades before rollout.

tickets.title: Implement password recovery and secure invitation acceptance
tickets.evidence: Password login exists; recovery and invitation lifecycle are not present in the current auth controller.
acceptance: Persist hashed expiring single-use reset/invitation tokens and redact them from logs; provide privacy-safe reset responses.
Make invitation acceptance bind the intended verified identity and tenant membership; reject altered tenant/role fields.
Commit password change, token consumption, session revocation and security evidence atomically.
Use a configured transactional mail adapter with retries and a local test sink; document provider configuration without embedding secrets.
Test replay, expiry, enumeration, resend invalidation and concurrent acceptance/reset.

tickets.title: Add MFA, step-up authentication and session self-service
tickets.evidence: State-backed sessions and refresh rotation exist; MFA enrollment, recovery codes and user session management are missing.
acceptance: Implement enrollment confirmation, login challenge, single-use hashed recovery codes and reauthentication before disable/regenerate/revoke actions.
Require configured privileged-role MFA; encrypt enrollment secrets and never return them outside setup.
List only safe session metadata; revoke one or all-other sessions with immediate guard enforcement.
Test TOTP replay/window limits, brute-force limits, recovery races, session theft and secret redaction; document signing-key rotation and previous-key retirement.

tickets.title: Implement personal account settings and safe preference updates
tickets.evidence: Current-user and effective-access responses exist; profile, locale/timezone and persisted personal preferences are incomplete.
acceptance: Expose validated profile, locale, IANA timezone and accessibility preferences for the authenticated identity.
Keep identity fields distinct from tenant-scoped preferences; role, status and tenant authority cannot be changed through profile PATCH.
Use optimistic concurrency for mutable settings; return a structured stale-write conflict.
Test field allowlists, invalid timezone/locale, own-record access and preference isolation across memberships.

tickets.title: Publish versioned OpenAPI and a compatibility contract for existing clients
tickets.evidence: Build list proposes /api/v1 and different resource names; current API uses unversioned campaign-prospect routes and prose documentation.
acceptance: Map every proposed endpoint to an implemented route, compatibility alias, extension or intentionally deferred contract; distinguish establishmentId from campaignProspectId.
Generate versioned OpenAPI with request/response DTOs, permission scope, errors, pagination, limits, idempotency and concurrency semantics.
Preserve current web clients through additive aliases or a coordinated version switch; test both during transition.
For each new mutation define idempotency key scope, request hash, expiry and replay; for mutable resources define ETag/If-Match conflict behavior.
Fail CI on unreviewed incompatible contract changes; expose no secret/session internal fields.

tickets.title: Harden HTTP limits, authentication throttling and proxy boundaries
tickets.evidence: Global DTO validation exists; bootstrap has no explicit security headers, origin policy or rate-limit configuration.
acceptance: Set explicit request/body/upload limits, security headers and trusted-proxy behavior; configure allowed origins for the actual BFF deployment.
Apply distributed per-identity/IP throttling for login, refresh, recovery and MFA without user enumeration.
Test oversized payloads, spoofed forwarded IP, disallowed origins, burst requests and redaction of credentials.
Expose validated configuration defaults and deploy documentation; do not break same-origin authenticated frontend calls.

tickets.title: Complete tenant and membership administration with scope history
tickets.evidence: Tenant services and user/grant APIs exist; invitations, capacity and complete membership administration are not covered.
acceptance: Implement tenant settings, membership listing/detail, invitations, suspension/reactivation and scoped grant/restriction lifecycle.
Expose the canonical role/permission catalogue; prevent removal of the last active tenant administrator and privilege escalation.
Audit actor, reason and previous/new effective scope in the same transaction; revoke affected sessions immediately.
Test role changes, concurrent last-admin removal, invite resend, inactive team/campaign grants and historical access queries.

tickets.title: Expose organization, team and effective-dated team membership APIs
tickets.evidence: Organization/team repositories and services exist without full management controllers; a remote administration UI branch must be reused.
acceptance: Implement scoped organization/team CRUD, organization relationships and effective-dated team membership with capacity.
Reject hierarchy cycles and cross-tenant/team-manager references; enforce Manager scope and Admin-only configuration.
Deactivate rather than erase referenced business masters; define active-assignment handling before deactivation.
Test idempotent membership changes, concurrent edits, capacity summaries and historical visibility.

tickets.title: Complete territories and permission-filtered map feeds
tickets.evidence: Regions and PostGIS nearby queries exist; scoped territory responsibility and map aggregation contracts are incomplete.
acceptance: Map existing regions to territories through compatible migrations; support validated geometry, hierarchy and effective assignments.
Return bounded GeoJSON/cluster feeds filtered by current grants, campaign and viewport; validate radius and result limits.
Do not reveal exact coordinates, names or per-record identifiers for out-of-scope prospects; any restricted context must use approved coarse aggregates.
Test invalid geometry, cycles, overlapping assignments, cross-tenant polygons, pagination and index-supported viewport queries.

tickets.title: Complete campaign lifecycle, participation and scoped management
tickets.evidence: Campaign CRUD and campaign-prospect membership exist; full organization/territory/member participation is missing.
acceptance: Support explicit draft/activate/pause/complete/archive transitions with audited preconditions.
Add organization participation/access modes, territories and membership/team participation while retaining campaign-prospect identity.
Authorize Managers only within effective scope and deny Director operational writes.
Define active reservation, action and assignment behavior on pause/archive; test invalid transitions and stale changes.

tickets.title: Complete scoped prospect repository, search and lifecycle metadata
tickets.evidence: Admin establishment CRUD and Prospector work queue exist; shared Manager/Director/Observer search/detail and explicit lifecycle transitions are incomplete.
acceptance: Expose resource-based search/detail and archive/restore while preserving canonical establishment identity and campaign-specific lifecycle.
Provide authorization-filtered search/facets/status metadata with stable cursor ordering and limits; avoid count-based scope leaks.
Define explicit refusal, no-answer, invalid-contact and opposition outcomes separately from assignment/collision state.
Use measured search indexes and query plans; test grants, duplicate sort keys, deleted records and updates between pages.

tickets.title: Enrich prospect contacts and manage multiple addresses
tickets.evidence: Establishment contact CRUD and a single location exist; preferred channel/language, address lifecycle and contact detail contract need expansion.
acceptance: Add scoped contact name/role/channel/language and normalized communication fields plus multi-site address/primary selection.
Validate related prospect/contact/assignment membership through tenant-safe foreign keys.
Keep historical action contact snapshots stable when current contact data changes; soft-delete referenced contacts.
Test duplicate contacts, concurrent primary-address changes, invalid coordinates and unauthorized enrichment.

tickets.title: Enforce consent, opposition and channel-specific do-not-contact rules
tickets.evidence: No durable consent/opposition schema or collision enforcement exists in the current implementation.
acceptance: Append contact/prospect/channel decisions with reason, evidence, actor and effective interval; derive current blocking status.
Recheck hard opposition before claim, action start and action completion where applicable; Manager overrides must not bypass hard do-not-contact rules.
Define contact-specific versus establishment-wide precedence and expiry; audit every change.
Test opposition racing with claim/action, channel-specific blocks, expiry, tenant isolation and redacted evidence reads.

tickets.title: Add tenant tags, custom fields and data-quality guidance
tickets.evidence: No tag/custom-field persistence exists; design requires configurable enrichment and quality guidance.
acceptance: Implement tenant-scoped tag and typed custom-field definitions, validation, visibility and prospect values.
Support safe definition retirement/type changes without silently corrupting existing values.
Return missing/invalid-field guidance and reproducible quality scores using versioned rules.
Test hidden-field exclusion from search/export, malformed values, tenant boundaries and concurrent updates.

tickets.title: Build durable CSV/XLSX import staging, correction and commit workflow
tickets.evidence: Synchronous CSV preview/execution exists; frontend-dev already has an import page, but durable jobs/rows/issues and XLSX import are missing.
acceptance: Persist import files, mappings, normalized rows, issues and resumable job state; add bounded CSV/XLSX parsing and formula/malicious-file defenses.
Implement map/normalize/validate/correct/revalidate/finalize/cancel/report flow; only validated authorized rows enter active data.
Specify an atomic finalization boundary and configurable maximum import size; do not promise one unbounded transaction for arbitrary file size.
Make worker retries/finalize idempotent with tenant-bound jobs and outbox progress; test duplicate delivery, crash recovery and concurrent finalization.
Use the 2,584-establishment pilot shape with synthetic data; report counts that reconcile accepted/rejected/duplicate rows.

tickets.title: Implement duplicate candidate review and audited transactional merge
tickets.evidence: Imports detect exact duplicates; no durable fuzzy candidates, review decisions or merge workflow exist.
acceptance: Generate explainable candidate scores from normalized identity keys; never auto-merge based solely on fuzzy similarity.
Support compare, reject and explicitly confirmed merge with per-field winner selection and immutable provenance.
Resolve campaign-membership/assignment uniqueness and active reservations before merge; preserve action/audit identity and references.
Test merges sharing the same campaign, concurrent merges, stale review, cross-tenant pairs and rollback on any dependent write failure.

tickets.title: Complete scoped assignment lifecycle and read/history access
tickets.evidence: Local Manager assignment writes are in progress; assignment GET/history remain ClientAdminGuard-protected and close/revoke semantics are incomplete.
acceptance: Finish Manager-scoped assign/reassign/unassign plus authorized current/history/list/unassigned reads.
Implement explicit completion/revocation with reasons and defined handling of open actions, follow-ups and reservations.
Check authority over both previous and target ownership; enforce one active assignment under concurrent requests.
Retain same-transaction audit and idempotency; cover no-op reassignments, stale ownership and audit failure rollback over HTTP.

tickets.title: Implement assignment-lot preview, apply, reassign and close
tickets.evidence: Individual assignment operations exist; the dossier MVP explicitly requires Manager batch assignment/reassignment/closure.
acceptance: Accept bounded explicit prospect sets and return preview counts, permissions, conflicts and resulting ownership.
Bind preview to versioned inputs; revalidate at apply and reject stale or unauthorized items according to documented atomic batch semantics.
Support assign/reassign/close with reasons and reservation/open-action disposition; no file export required.
Prove all-or-nothing bounded batches, idempotent retry, concurrent competing lots and audit count reconciliation.

tickets.title: Add simulated capacity and rule-based assignment strategies
tickets.evidence: Capacity/round-robin/skills/proximity allocation is in the design but has no strategy engine.
acceptance: Implement versioned allocation rules with deterministic preview, capacity constraints and explicit activation.
Provide suggestions with explanations; no automatic write can escape the reviewed scope or batch authorization.
Handle unavailable users, exhausted capacity, ties and fallback strategies deterministically.
Test reproducible simulation/apply, changed capacity, rule order and grant revocation.

tickets.title: Make reservation ownership durable and recoverable across failures
tickets.evidence: Redis Lua claims provide a tested runtime concurrency boundary; reference SQL proposes a different durable lock model.
acceptance: Record an ADR selecting one authoritative claim state and canonical collision key across campaigns; preserve existing exactly-one-winner behavior.
Persist claim/reject/release/expiry evidence and use fencing/version tokens so stale owners cannot act after expiry or failover.
Implement heartbeat/extend/release policy, durable expiry reconciliation and crash recovery; never describe Redis plus PostgreSQL writes as one atomic transaction.
Test simultaneous claims from multiple API instances, stale release, worker outage, Redis restart, DB failure and cross-campaign organization policy.

tickets.title: Version collision policies and persist explainable decision evidence
tickets.evidence: Assignment/planned-action/reservation/cooldown/org-policy checks exist; duplicate/opposition layers and policy administration are incomplete.
acceptance: Expose scoped reservation/cooldown/compatibility policy administration with audit and explicit defaults; keep sample coordination matrix configurable.
Run canonical duplicate, assignment, planned action, lock, cooldown, multi-brand and override rules in deterministic order.
Persist policy version, decision, safe reasons and correlation IDs for checks including allowed/blocked/validation-required outcomes.
Return actionable but redacted conflict context; test policy edits racing with claims, shared canonical prospects across campaigns and non-overridable opposition.

tickets.title: Implement request-to-decision Manager override workflow
tickets.evidence: Immediate scoped override approval exists; Prospector request, Manager inbox and rejected/expired request states are absent.
acceptance: Persist request, conflict/policy snapshot, reason, approver, decision, validity interval and terminal state.
Expose own cancellation and scoped Manager/Admin approve/reject; Director/Auditor cannot decide.
Re-evaluate current assignment, opposition and lock state at approval; enforce one decision and bounded authority, not permanent permission.
Emit audited notification events and test concurrent approve/reject, expiry, changed policy, replay and denied scope.

tickets.title: Introduce planned actions and rich immutable outcome contracts
tickets.evidence: CreateProspectActivityDto currently accepts only type; dossier requires contact or reason, outcome, structures, summary and next step.
acceptance: Add planned/open action lifecycle with channel, due time, priority, assignee and start/cancel rules.
Define versioned outcome/contact-or-reason/structures/languages/document metadata/summary/duration fields and explicit next-step-or-closure validation.
Keep existing activity history readable; migrate append-only outcome/event tables without rewriting old authored evidence.
Enforce scoped author/assignment/contact relationships and prohibit PATCH of completed outcomes; test required fields, invalid transitions and stale writes.

tickets.title: Complete actions with one reliable outcome/lifecycle/follow-up operation
tickets.evidence: Current reservation-bound activity recording does not implement the complete rich action transaction from the build list.
acceptance: Atomically commit outcome, explicit campaign lifecycle event, permitted contact updates, optional next follow-up, audit and transactional outbox.
Use the reservation authority/reconciliation design for lock disposition; crash/retry must never double-log or leave a stale claim usable.
Require idempotency and action version/fencing checks; revalidate authorization and hard opposition.
Test lost response followed by retry, double completion, audit/outbox failure, changed ownership and reservation-service outage.

tickets.title: Provide a unified timeline and reasoned corrections
tickets.evidence: Activity timeline exists; assignment, reservation, override, follow-up and lifecycle events are not unified.
acceptance: Return stable cursor-ordered events with type, actor, time, scope and immutable event ID across operational domains.
Add correction events that reference original evidence, preserve original values and require actor/reason.
Use safe projections so out-of-scope identities, audit payloads and future messaging contents cannot leak.
Test tie timestamps, pagination during append, historical assignment changes and tamper attempts at the DB role boundary.

tickets.title: Finish follow-up attribution, action linkage and Today semantics
tickets.evidence: Follow-up CRUD/state transitions and timezone-aware Today exist locally; completion actor, cancel reason and resulting activity linkage are incomplete.
acceptance: Persist completion/cancellation actor, reason, source action and resulting action without losing reassignment history.
Reject terminal-state rewrites and make reschedule/complete/cancel idempotent and scope-aware.
Reconcile reminders after changes and define Today due/overdue/completed counts using the selected IANA timezone.
Test DST days, reassignment, reminder races, duplicate completion and UTC boundary paging.

tickets.title: Add durable event delivery and scoped realtime operational alerts
tickets.evidence: BullMQ follow-up reminders and in-app notifications exist; transactional outbox and reconnectable event channels are missing.
acceptance: Persist outbox events with business writes, dispatch with at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers.
Implement safe notification list/unread/read-all plus SSE or WebSocket subscriptions for reservations, notifications and import/export progress.
Authorize each subscription and event; revoke on membership change, support reconnect cursor and avoid replaying inaccessible payloads.
Keep collision/opposition/security alerts mandatory; test rollback before publish, duplicate delivery, reconnect gaps and cross-tenant subscribers.

tickets.title: Complete notification preferences, email/push delivery and escalation
tickets.evidence: Only basic in-app follow-up reminders are implemented; design includes channels, templates, digest and escalation controls.
acceptance: Persist per-membership preferences and tenant policies/templates with mandatory security/coordination events locked on.
Add device lifecycle and configured email/push adapters with dedupe, retry, delivery history and safe template rendering.
Implement due follow-up, unlogged expired reservation, override decision and inactivity escalation policies.
Test revoked devices, suspended users, opt-out attempts for mandatory alerts, bounce/retry and duplicate delivery.

contributing_pages.scope: Optional channels, templates and digest delivery

tickets.title: Complete operational reports with defined historical metrics
tickets.evidence: Manager dashboard metrics exist; dossier channel/territory/conversion/quality/reassignment dimensions are incomplete.
acceptance: Define metric denominators, event-time attribution, working-day calendar, timezone, freshness and zero-denominator behavior.
Implement workload, actions, funnel, conversions, timeliness, coverage, collision and quality reports plus tenant overview.
Apply identical authorized period/org/team/territory/campaign/manager/prospector/channel scope to totals and drill-down.
Use historical events/effective assignments, not only current mutable state; test reassignment, corrections, DST and forbidden dimensions.
Measure queries on a synthetic pilot dataset and larger fixture; add materialized views only where measured need justifies refresh complexity.

tickets.title: Implement objectives and explainable Director forecasts
tickets.evidence: No objective/history or forecast persistence exists; Director design expects read-only targets and confidence/assumptions.
acceptance: Add versioned targets and objective history with authorized Admin/Manager writes and Director read-only access.
Calculate actuals through the canonical metric definitions and expose risk/freshness/assumptions.
Use a documented deterministic initial forecast with confidence limits and insufficient-data state; do not invent AI predictions.
Test edited future targets, historical reproducibility, sparse samples and scope-preserving drill-down.

tickets.title: Add reproducible report definitions and authorized scheduled delivery
tickets.evidence: No saved report definition/schedule/delivery model exists.
acceptance: Persist report definitions, reproducible filter versions, cadence and delivery history.
Allow Directors to manage personal schedules without changing business data; reauthorize recipients/scope at generation and download.
Generate large reports asynchronously with idempotent retry and expiry; redact forbidden fields.
Test timezone schedules, revoked recipient access, duplicate jobs, failed delivery and cancellation.

tickets.title: Persist personal and scoped shared saved views
tickets.evidence: Work queue filters exist but are not persisted as saved views.
acceptance: Store owner/membership, resource, validated filters/sort/columns/default and private/team/tenant visibility.
Treat stored filters as untrusted input; reapply current permissions on every execution.
Enforce share/edit/delete rules and optimistic concurrency; no saved view grants data access.
Test revoked grants, unknown filter fields, shared-view edits, workspace switching and stale versions.

tickets.title: Build asynchronous controlled export lifecycle and download evidence
tickets.evidence: Scoped audited CSV/XLSX serialization exists for three types; durable jobs, preview, expiry and download reauthorization are missing.
acceptance: Add preview with permitted fields/row estimate/purpose, job status/cancel, expiry and authorized download.
Snapshot request filters but reauthorize at execution and download; deny revoked or reduced access.
Keep CSV/XLSX formula injection protection, field redaction, checksum and immutable generation/download audit.
Use private object storage and short-lived downloads; test replayed jobs, expiry, cancellation, worker failure and cross-tenant job IDs.

tickets.title: Expose scoped immutable audit and operational evidence registers
tickets.evidence: Transactional audit writes exist; read/search APIs and complete event coverage are missing.
acceptance: Implement cursor search/detail and assignment/override/collision/export/security/data-change registers within effective read scope.
Define evidence coverage and safe actor/request/before-after projections; distinguish redacted, absent and unchanged values.
Make Director/Auditor reads safe and refuse all source-evidence mutations; do not claim cryptographic integrity without an implemented scheme.
Test append-only DB permissions, scope leaks, stable ordering, sensitive field redaction and audited evidence access/export.

tickets.title: Implement retention, legal holds and privacy lifecycle workflows
tickets.evidence: Retention/erasure/legal-hold controls are listed as production gates but have no operational implementation.
acceptance: Version retention rules by data class and implement auditable legal holds, dry-run previews and resumable retention runs.
Define export/access request, erasure/anonymization and archival handling across DB, files, queues, caches and backups.
Preserve required immutable evidence through an explicit minimal/pseudonymized representation; no blanket cascade delete of history.
Test held records, partial job failure, idempotent rerun and verification of removed data; require policy-owner input for actual durations before activation.

Publish explicit privacy-request, retention-policy/version/run and legal-hold request/response/error/permission/state-machine contracts in OpenAPI before implementing them; these operations are additions to the supplied API list.

tickets.title: Implement access reviews and verifiable evidence packages
tickets.evidence: Auditor pages require access-review periods and signed/versioned reports, neither implemented.
acceptance: Create Admin-owned review periods with frozen membership/scope evidence, assigned reviewers and sealed decisions.
Keep Auditor read-only; explicit reviewer capability is separate from evidence inspection.
Generate versioned, redacted evidence/compliance packages with checksum/signature manifest and audited download.
Test unauthorized decisions, post-seal changes, redacted references, signature verification and revoked download access.

tickets.title: Provide private file storage, upload validation and authorized attachments
tickets.evidence: No object-storage upload/attachment service exists; import/export workflows and notes/messages depend on it.
acceptance: Define provider-neutral private storage adapter and tenant/owner/resource-bound upload sessions; configure provider before deployment.
Verify actual MIME, size, checksum and quarantine/scan status before attachment; do not trust client metadata.
Reauthorize every download; use short expiry and clean abandoned uploads through resumable jobs.
Support authorized note/avatar/message attachments and prospect notes with visibility/version rules; test cross-tenant object keys, malicious files, replay and orphan cleanup.

tickets.title: Implement participant-scoped contextual messaging
tickets.evidence: Messaging is shown in the design but no conversation/message module exists.
acceptance: Add conversations, participants, context links, messages, read cursors and mute state.
Check both participant membership and linked-resource access on read/send; Administrator role alone must not expose private conversations.
Restrict edits/deletes to authorized human messages; system events remain immutable.
Emit scoped realtime events and handle attachment authorization; test removal, context revocation, unread races and cross-tenant participant injection.

tickets.title: Implement manual field rounds and ordered stop execution
tickets.evidence: No route/stop model exists; design includes manual planning and live rounds.
acceptance: Support own/scoped routes, ordered stops, draft changes, start/arrive/skip/complete and navigation links.
Validate every stop against current assignment/access; route membership does not reserve or authorize outreach.
Use optimistic versions for reordering and auditable outcomes; preserve completed round history.
Test duplicate stops, concurrent reorder, withdrawn access, missing coordinates and interrupted execution.

tickets.title: Add route optimization with provider limits and explicit fallback
tickets.evidence: API build list labels optimization P1, but the original dossier explicitly places route optimization in V2.
acceptance: Select a routing provider and document cost/privacy/region constraints before activation.
Optimize a bounded authorized stop set asynchronously with travel mode, endpoints and reproducible input version.
Show provider estimates as estimates; fallback to saved manual order on failure.
Test stale routes, provider timeout/quota, inaccessible stops and cancellation; do not block operational MVP.

tickets.title: Implement configured calendar and email integrations
tickets.evidence: Provider connection and SSO APIs are design-only; original dossier places SSO in V2.
acceptance: Keep calendar/email OAuth integrations separate from identity SSO; ship one explicitly configured provider per logical PR.
Bind state/PKCE/redirects to the initiating identity/membership; encrypt refresh tokens and support revocation.
Track idempotent sync cursors/conflicts with minimal provider scopes and safe connection diagnostics.
Test callback forgery, token expiry, cross-workspace linking and duplicate events.

tickets.title: Implement scoped API clients and secure webhook delivery
tickets.evidence: No API-client, webhook or delivery dispatcher exists.
acceptance: Create expiring scoped clients with hashed secrets returned once and audited rotation/revocation.
Publish versioned outbox events to signed subscriptions with retry/backoff, dead-letter state and authorized redrive.
Restrict destinations and redirects to prevent SSRF, bound response/payload sizes and redact diagnostics.
Test signature rotation, replay protection, revoked scopes, duplicate delivery and private-network destination rejection.

tickets.title: Implement partial offline synchronization without offline reservation claims
tickets.evidence: Offline pages/drafts are in the handoff; no bootstrap/change/replay backend exists.
acceptance: Define minimal scoped bootstrap/change feed with tombstones, schema version, cursor expiry and full-resync behavior.
Replay queued safe operations idempotently with explicit conflicts and current authorization.
Do not allow offline outreach authorization/reservation acquisition; drafts remain pending until server validation.
Test revoked membership, device workspace switch, deleted data, stale lifecycle and duplicate replay; clear protected local caches on logout.

tickets.title: Implement separate platform authorization and bounded support access
tickets.evidence: Local platform/support grant tables are dormant; no control-plane authorization flow exists.
acceptance: Require explicit platform grants/MFA on platform endpoints; platform access grants no default tenant business-data access.
Implement reasoned support requests with tenant approval, resource scope, expiry, revocation and distinct support session context.
Record every support read/write and prevent support from approving its own request or expanding its grant.
Test expired/revoked sessions, confused-deputy tenant switching, self-approval and tenant approval audit.
Publish tenant-approval/rejection and support-session issuance/termination contracts with DTOs, errors and state preconditions; these required operations are missing from the supplied API inventory.

tickets.title: Implement tenant provisioning and platform identity administration
tickets.evidence: Tenant domain exists but platform provisioning/control and identity recovery are not implemented.
acceptance: Provide idempotent tenant provisioning with initial administrator invitation and compensating cleanup on partial failure.
Expose safe platform directory/details, suspend/reactivate and identity unlock with reason/step-up/audit.
Show operational metadata only; tenant business records require separate approved support access.
Test provisioning retries, last-admin setup, suspended-tenant sessions and authorization segregation.

tickets.title: Implement versioned plans, subscriptions, quotas and feature flags
tickets.evidence: Reference architecture describes billing/flags; feature_flags is absent even from the supplied SQL.
acceptance: Version plans/entitlements and support tenant/global rollout with audit and emergency disable.
Integrate billing only after provider/pricing decisions; verify signed billing events and idempotent lifecycle transitions.
Enforce quotas at authoritative API boundaries and expose safe tenant usage/portal flows.
Test seat races, downgrade over quota, duplicate billing events, cross-tenant flag edits and provider outage.

tickets.title: Expose safe platform service health and background-job operations
tickets.evidence: Worker retry/backoff exists; no platform queue inspection/redrive/cancel UI contract exists.
acceptance: Expose aggregate health and searchable job metadata through platform authorization without raw secrets/business payloads.
Implement bounded retry/cancel controls using per-job supported state transitions and audit.
Include queue age, attempts, dead-letter and owner/runbook references.
Test unauthorized payload access, repeat retries, jobs already running and worker outage.

tickets.title: Implement platform incidents, configuration and release records
tickets.evidence: Security-center and release/configuration screens are design-only.
acceptance: Persist incident evidence, containment/resolution decisions and platform configuration versions.
Expose safe release/rollout records; distinguish recording a rollback from executing infrastructure deployment.
Any deployment execution requires configured provider credentials, bounded privileges and a separate reviewed adapter.
Test unauthorized containment, stale configuration, repeated rollout and immutable incident evidence.

tickets.title: Add dependency readiness, structured telemetry and resilient worker operations
tickets.evidence: GET /health returns static status ok; production readiness and telemetry are not established.
acceptance: Separate cheap liveness from bounded readiness checks for PostgreSQL, Redis and required queue dependencies; report worker heartbeat separately.
Add redacted structured request/job logs, correlation IDs, metrics and trace propagation with explicit failure alerts.
Define dead-letter/redrive behavior, poison-job limits and graceful shutdown handling.
